items.context: The Republican majority staff report says the Justice Department failed to black out some survivors’ identifying details before releasing records, exposing survivors’ personal information. The majority staff also said its investigation found no evidence that Trump participated in Epstein’s crimes.

items.text: Thomas Massie’s petition for another Epstein records vote reaches 218 House signatures
items.context: Representative John Garamendi supplied the final signature on November 11. Four Republicans and 214 Democrats signed. The proposal would let survivors, state prosecutors and lawmakers sue the Justice Department over records they believe it unlawfully withheld. The White House defended its existing disclosures in a statement to Axios. Speaker Mike Johnson’s office did not respond to Axios.
items.rationale: My reading: Massie can use a House petition to seek floor time without the speaker’s agreement. The House still has to vote on the bill.
